verdict.rationale: Jan is marketed as downloading and running LLMs (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, GPT-oss) from HuggingFace with full local control, which in practice implies GGUF-packaged models (the standard format for such local runners), but no evidence explicitly names GGUF format support or details quantization handling. Missing for 10: explicit mention of GGUF format, documentation on quantization levels/compatibility, and hands-on confirmation of loading arbitrary GGUF files.
